 Horticultural Seedling Production Ahead of the Rainy Season
 19th November 2026 17:40 GMT+7
 Workers tend to chili seedlings at the Sukomaju seedling center, Banyuwangi, East Java, Thursday (19/11/2026). Horticultural seedling cultivators in the area record that the production of horticultural seedlings such as vegetables, fruits, and medicinal plants during the dry season usually only reaches 50 percent or 382,500 seedlings from the maximum capacity of 765,000 seedlings, but it has now increased to nearly full capacity due to high demand ahead of the rainy season. ANTARA FOTO/Budi Candra Setya/agr
